newsitem.title: USA: USG Corp Q3 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: USG Corp Q3 profit vs loss.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q3 1996 earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) $125 million vs $106 million.

Non-cash amortization of excess reorganization value and reorganization debt discount reduced reported Q3 1996 net earnings by $43.0 million or $0.89 a share and Q3 1995 net earnings by $44.0 million or $0.97 a share.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Nine-month 1996 EBITA $314.0 million vs $315.0 million.

Non-cash amortization of excess reorganization value and reorganization debt discount reduced nine-month 1996 results by $128.0 million or $2.69 a share and nine-month 1996 results by $130.0 million or $2.88 a share.

Net earnings per share in Q3 1996 were calculated using diluted commmon shares of 47,609,417, including common stock equivalents of 2,060,833. In the nine-month 1996 period, earnings per share were calculated with 47,582,237, including 2,087,506 common stock equivalents.
